description: Send one transactional email (login code, receipt, notification) through Vaartix. Returns the email ID. Before calling, show the user the sender, every recipient, the subject and the body, and get their explicit confirmation. It delivers real email. At most 50 recipients; no attachments.

bcc.description: One address or a list, e.g. "priya@example.com" or "Priya <priya@example.com>"

cc.description: One address or a list, e.g. "priya@example.com" or "Priya <priya@example.com>"

from.description: Sender on a domain verified in Vaartix, e.g. "Acme <hello@notify.acme.in>"

html.description: HTML body. Give html, text or both.

idempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key within 24 hours returns the first email instead of sending again

replyTo.description: Where replies go: one address or up to 5

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time to send later, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+05:30

tags.description: Name/value tags to filter and group emails

text.description: Plain-text body. Give html, text or both.

to.description: One address or a list, e.g. "priya@example.com" or "Priya <priya@example.com>"

name: send_email
title: Send email
